ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and mark this driver cancellation as fee-invalid; no further account action needed.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that he waited for the rider is a claim contradicted by system records: GPS shows only 2 min 30 s cumulative within 200 m (F2) and 1 min 40 s after the 'I'm Here' tap (F6), short of the >3 min required by NS-1(iii).
Chat message 'Waited more than 3 min' is inconsistent with the GPS/timeline measurement of waiting time; system records prevail over statements.
